installCommand: APP_DIR=""; if [ -d "Source Code/admin/admin/frontend/frontend" ]; then APP_DIR="Source Code/admin/admin/frontend/frontend"; elif [ -d "admin/admin/frontend/frontend" ]; then APP_DIR="admin/admin/frontend/frontend"; else echo "Frontend app path not found"; exit 1; fi; npm --prefix "$APP_DIR" install
buildCommand: APP_DIR=""; if [ -d "Source Code/admin/admin/frontend/frontend" ]; then APP_DIR="Source Code/admin/admin/frontend/frontend"; elif [ -d "admin/admin/frontend/frontend" ]; then APP_DIR="admin/admin/frontend/frontend"; else echo "Frontend app path not found"; exit 1; fi; npm --prefix "$APP_DIR" run build; rm -rf build; cp -R "$APP_DIR/build" build
